mapper.select: select m.id as modelId, m.model_code as modelCode, m.model_name as modelName, m.billing_type as billingType, m.prompt_price as promptPrice, m.cached_prompt_price as cachedPromptPrice, m.cache_write_prompt_price as cacheWritePromptPrice, m.completion_price as completionPrice, m.request_price as requestPrice, m.multiplier, p.id as providerId, p.provider_name as providerName, p.base_url as baseUrl, p.provider_type as providerType, p.timeout_ms as timeoutMs, r.upstream_model as upstreamModel, t.id as providerTokenId, t.token_value_encrypted as tokenValueEncrypted from models m join model_routes r on r.model_id = m.id and r.status = 'ACTIVE' join providers p on p.id = r.provider_id and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' join provider_tokens t on t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 'ACTIVE' and (r.provider_token_id is null or r.provider_token_id = t.id) where m.model_code = #{modelCode} and m.deleted = 0 and m.status = 'ACTIVE' order by r.priority_no asc, case when r.provider_token_id = t.id then 0 else 1 end, t.weight_no desc, t.id asc limit 1

select m.id as modelId, m.model_code as modelCode, m.model_name as modelName, m.billing_type as billingType, m.prompt_price as promptPrice, m.cached_prompt_price as cachedPromptPrice, m.cache_write_prompt_price as cacheWritePromptPrice, m.completion_price as completionPrice, m.request_price as requestPrice, m.multiplier, p.id as providerId, p.provider_name as providerName, p.base_url as baseUrl, p.provider_type as providerType, p.timeout_ms as timeoutMs, r.upstream_model as upstreamModel, t.id as providerTokenId, t.token_value_encrypted as tokenValueEncrypted from model_routes r join models m on m.id = r.model_id and m.deleted = 0 join providers p on p.id = r.provider_id and p.deleted = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' join provider_tokens t on t.provider_id = p.id and t.deleted = 0 and t.status = 'ACTIVE' and (r.provider_token_id is null or r.provider_token_id = t.id) where r.provider_id = #{providerId} and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and r.route_type = 'PRIMARY' and m.status = 'ACTIVE' order by r.priority_no asc, t.weight_no desc, t.id asc
